articles.summary: Banner Corporation (NASDAQ: BANR) (“Banner”), the parent company of Banner Bank, today reported net income of $53.5 million, or $1.54 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2025, compared to $45.5 million, or $1.31 per diluted share, for the preceding quarter and $45.2 million, or $1.30 per diluted share, for the third quarter of 2024.
